home: Temple of the Eternal Flame, Dravesa
and_yet: Moves with the unhurried precision of someone who has already decided how she will die.
wants: The Orthodox to outlast the schism.
oddly_also: Orziben's cleric died two months ago — she is the last senior Orthodox cleric alive, and has told no one.
family: Widowed; two adult children in Orziben she corresponds with rarely.
recreation: Tends the temple flame personally each dawn, regardless of who else is on duty.
dreams: A proper successor before she dies.
anecdotes: Refused to close the temple during a Bronze Host siege; conducted full services with arrows in the door.
tragedies: One of her Fire-seers defected to the Schismatics three years ago. She blamed herself.
pc_leverage: Has a deposition — Savar met Jorun alone six times before his pilgrimage. Will share it with someone she trusts to use it correctly.
